name: Since I Saw You
source: You've always lived life by the rules. But when your boss assigns you to assist his handsome but devilish half-brother, all rules go out the window. Every passionate night with the kinky and sensual Kam Reardon has you craving more. Are you ready to let go of your inhibitions and embrace your darkest pleasures?
translation: 你一直循规蹈矩。然而，当上司派你去协助他英俊却邪气的同父异母兄弟，所有规则都被抛到了九霄云外。与性感、爱好特殊情趣的卡姆·里尔登共度的每一个激情夜晚都让你渴望更多。你准备好，放下拘束，拥抱内心最隐秘的欢愉了吗？
